svg.title: Chisum: Main switchboard: the 440 V and 230 V sections, JS8-865 revision 0
svg.text: Main switchboard: the 440 V and 230 V sections, every way · JS8-865 · revision 0 · 12 November 2026
Sheet 2 of 2. The row that faces the 690 V board, on the place marked PSB. Each way: what it feeds, what is on it, its breaker and its cable. These are the connections a cable is landed on.
Powers are the design basis's (its load list); the gathering onto ways is the yard's.
THE 440 V SECTION: two halves behind transformers No. 1 and No. 2, tied; three-phase, three-wire, insulated
What is on it, and where it goes
Main engines' lubricating oil, jacket water, sea water, nozzle cooling, pitch oil and gear pumps, port side; fuel
booster, circulating and transfer pumps; separators No. 1. To: Engine room platform, port
The 230 V section, port half. To: Main switchboard room
The emergency switchboard while there is main power. To: Emergency generator room, officers' deck
Two main pumps of 37 kW, cleat pump, cooler fan, control. As registered (systems/stern.py): cable W-RMP-01. To:
Two pumps of 45 kW of the lift's power pack. To: Hydraulic pump room, main deck
Two pumps of 55 kW: both windlasses and mooring winches on the forecastle. To: Fore store, main deck forward
One of the two exclusive circuits (the other is from the emergency switchboard). To: Steering gear room
Bilge and general service pump No. 1
Ballast pump No. 2 and heeling pump
Engine room and auxiliary engine room supply fans, separator room, workshop, steering gear and store fans. To: Engine
Four main deck exhaust fans, two supply fans, lower hold exhaust and supply fans, all two-speed. To: Main deck, port
From the shore box: in port with every set stopped. To: Main deck, port pilot door lobby
The same pumps, starboard side; harbour sea water pump, stern tube pump, diesel oil transfer and separator, sludge
pump; separators No. 2. To: Engine room platform, starboard
The 230 V section, starboard half. To: Main switchboard room
Range, ovens, fryer, dishwasher, boilers. To: Galley, boat deck
Ten sockets of 9 kW on the main deck. To: Main deck, starboard casing
Ten sockets of 9 kW on the upper deck. To: Upper deck
Compressor of 55 kW, air handling unit fan, sea water and chilled water pumps, provision refrigeration, galley and
sanitary exhaust fans. To: Air conditioning room
Two capstans of 15 kW, each side of the stern door. To: After mooring stations, main deck
Bilge and general service pump No. 2, bilge piston pump
Starting air compressor No. 2, control air compressor
Steam and water services starter board (SWB)
Boiler burner, feed, circulating and condensate pumps; hydrophores, hot water, calorifier heater, sewage plant, fresh
water generator. To: Auxiliary engine room
Pitch oil pump and room fan. To: Bow thruster room
Laundry, workshop machines and welding, pilot door power packs, provision crane, control room air conditioner. To:
THE 230 V SECTION: behind lighting transformers No. 1 and No. 2 (100 kVA each, 440/230 V), tied. Three-phase to each board; her lighting and socket circuits are two-wire from the boards
To: Navigation bridge: registered; its other feeder is from the emergency switchboard
Lighting board, officers' and bridge decks (LD1)
Lighting board, boat deck and accommodation (LD2)
Lighting board, forecastle and fore deck (LD3)
To: Fore store: the forecastle's lights, the windlasses' floodlights, the anchor light's local supply,
Deck floodlights, helideck and boat stations (LD4)
Lighting board, upper deck and lower hold (LD6)
Sockets and small power, decks and machinery (SP2)
To: Emergency generator room; engine control room
Navigation, radio and internal communication supplies
To: Navigation bridge; the emergency switchboard feeds the same boards
FOR THE BRIDGE AND THE FORECASTLE

· The navigation bridge is fed by ways L02 (the wheelhouse board BD1), L03 (the navigation light panel's main feeder), L04 (the fire detection panel) and L09 (the searchlight), which her register already has (systems/bridge.py), and by the emergency
switchboard and the two battery boards, which are not on this board.

· The forecastle is fed by way P07 (the forward mooring starter panel in the fore store: the two pumps of 55 kW that work both windlasses and mooring winches) and way L07 (lighting board LD3 in the fore store: the forecastle's lights and floodlights,
and sockets forward). The bow thruster's auxiliaries are way S13; the thruster itself is cubicle 9 of the 690 V board.

· Not on this board, and still to be drawn: the emergency switchboard and its ways (fed through P04); the group starter boards and the other boards named here, each of which is a board of its own with its own ways; the cable ways from this room to each
Made by ferry/yard/drawings/msb_drawing.py from ferry/blender/msb_place.py (the design basis's plant; the yard's gathering of its consumers onto ways): the numbers the board is to be built from.
